## Content checklist (skip if this is code only)

- [ ] `validate-pack` passes for the pack(s) I touched (it also checks the bank and the tags).
- [ ] Every new item has `tags`: one to three topics and the pack it is for. Any new tag is added to `data/tags.json` in this pull request.
- [ ] The questions are in my own words. Nothing is copied from exams, books, courses or other question banks.
- [ ] New items have no `reviewed_by`. The maintainer sets it after checking them against a source.
- [ ] Where a fact could be disputed, the item has `references`.
- [ ] If I changed an item that had `reviewed_by`, I removed it.
